_comment: S3 bucket policy — shramsafal-uploads-prod.
spec: FINAL_SERVER_AUTHORITATIVE_EXECUTION_PLAN §11 (S11-infra-author)
LIVE STATE CAPTURED 2026-08-15 (read-only, aws s3api get-bucket-policy):
NoSuchBucketPolicy — this bucket has NO policy today. Rollback for this
file is therefore 'delete the policy':
aws s3api delete-bucket-policy --bucket shramsafal-uploads-prod --region ap-south-1
Mirrors aws/snapshot/bucket-policy.json and aws/voice-retained/bucket-policy.json:
1. DenyInsecureTransport — block any S3 call not over TLS.
2. DenyUnencryptedUploads — block any PutObject that does not carry
x-amz-server-side-encryption: AES256 (this bucket's live default
encryption, confirmed 2026-08-15 via get-bucket-encryption — AES256,
BucketKeyEnabled=false; unchanged by this transaction).
3. DenyMissingEncryptionHeader — belt-and-braces: deny PutObject that
omits the header entirely (a bare AES256 StringNotEquals check alone
would allow an absent header through).
This bucket is NOT part of the CMK/encryption-rail item in §11 — that item
is scoped to the raw-blob bucket only (see aws/raw/). This policy does not
require or reference any KMS key and is safe to apply independently of the
CMK binding work.
APPLY (founder only): aws s3api put-bucket-policy --bucket shramsafal-uploads-prod --policy file://bucket-policy.json --region ap-south-1
(apply-config.sh does this as part of the single transaction.)
VERIFY: aws s3api get-bucket-policy --bucket shramsafal-uploads-prod --region ap-south-1 | jq -r '.Policy | fromjson | .Statement[].Sid'
